description: The gates that stand between a pair of executions and a publishable proof. Parity is proved from what each arm recorded, not assumed from the specification; the proof's own claim is established only by the arms' XI outcomes; and no projection reaches documentation or media until the redaction gate has passed.

contracts.title: Package artifact has the frozen shape
Both arms recorded the same model identity
contracts.input_contract: the model identity each arm recorded for itself
contracts.pass_condition: the two recorded model identities are canonically identical

contracts.title: Both arms ran against the same fixture
contracts.input_contract: the fixture identity each arm recorded for itself
contracts.pass_condition: the two recorded fixture identities are canonically identical

contracts.title: Both arms exposed the same tool surface
contracts.input_contract: the tool surface each arm recorded for itself
contracts.pass_condition: the two recorded tool surfaces are canonically identical

contracts.title: Configuration differs only by the declared changed variable
contracts.input_contract: both recorded configurations and the declared changed variable
contracts.pass_condition: the declared changed variable actually differs with the declared values and no other configuration key differs

contracts.title: Recorded executions match the specification they claim to implement
contracts.input_contract: the declared surface from the demo spec and both recorded arms
contracts.pass_condition: each arm's recorded model, tool surface, and configuration equal what the demo spec declared for it

contracts.title: Each arm file is bound to the artifact by canonical digest
contracts.pass_condition: each arm's document_sha256 equals the canonical digest of its own embedded evidence bundle and its arm_id agrees with the bundle

contracts.title: Both arms submitted complete evidence
contracts.pass_condition: each arm carries a non-empty transcript, a non-empty evidence set, a recorded XI outcome over the full arm contract set, and a raw-execution digest

contracts.title: The proof's own claim is established by the arms' XI outcomes
contracts.input_contract: the proof claim and both arms' XI outcomes
contracts.pass_condition: the baseline arm was rejected at the claim boundary, the augmented arm was admitted, and every code that blocked the baseline arm is absent from the augmented arm

contracts.title: Nothing the policy denies survives into the public surface
contracts.input_contract: the public projection, both arm bundles, and the redaction policy that produced them
contracts.pass_condition: no deny pattern matches any public surface and every policy rule was applied the number of times it declared
